wait.active-run: an active run is in progress
wait.in-progress: waiting for an operation in progress
wait.pool-all-kept: every environment in the kept pool has keep on
wait.pool-over: waiting for the kept pool overflow to clear

stop.cap: stopped because the running cap was exceeded
stop.done: stopped automatically after the run finished

destroy.pool: destroyed because the kept pool overflowed

messages.candidates: runs to stop first (oldest last up first):
messages.execFlowsUnknown: flows that can run again: the manifest has not been read yet
messages.hubWaitAgain: after the hub is up, wait again: {cmd} wait {id}
messages.merged: run {id}: merged into the queued run of the same commit and suite, queue position {position}
messages.metaOnly: finished without a bundle · stopped at stage {stage}
messages.poolAllKept: {line}: a person has to act. Every environment in the kept pool has keep on; release one to start: {cmd} unkeep <run id>
messages.redactionFailed: the bundle was discarded by the redaction rescan; files:
messages.reportPending: the report is written when the run finishes
messages.timeout: timed out; the run keeps going{now}. To wait again: {cmd} wait {id}
messages.waitResume: if the wait is cut: {cmd} wait {id}
